In the first quarter of 2023, **Fifth Third** reported nine points of year-over-year positive operating leverage driven by an 18% increase in revenue.

**Bank of America** described its operating leverage as part of a seven-quarter streak (noting that consumer banking specifically delivered its eighth consecutive quarter of strong operating leverage). This was supported by top-line revenue growth of 21% for the consumer banking segment, while overall company expenses rose 11%.
